name: Nyx animation API and an animated player and companion
body: `lantern::animation` host namespace so game code in Nyx creates an animator on an entity, defines states and transitions, sets parameters (speed, grounded, crouching) and look targets. The platformer's player and companion use a mannequin rig with idle, walk, run, jump, fall and crouch clips instead of capsules. The engine ships the mannequin so there is something to see before animated glTF import exists.
